notes: Subject insert. The two worlds only differ on the planet count and the outermost planet, both fol (arithmetic: a count and an ordering by distance), so they carry no axioms. q1 reads 'an object in a planetary system is at the system's distance from the Sun' as a firm rule over a relation. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): counts the members of a collection
fol (arithmetic): orders the planets by distance from the star

fol.notes: Planets are an enumeration (distinct by construction) with other_planet standing for any further planet; the closed list (no other known planet) is a presupposition. w1 stores the count and the outermost planet as summary facts; w2 stores the rules that read both off the list (count over the members; the member farther than every other). Farther-than is a Bool predicate with the stored order b to h and firm transitivity and asymmetry; outermost is local.

local.outermost: outermost(sys): the known planet of a system that orbits farthest from its star (an individual, not a value)

planet_list.says: TRAPPIST-1 b, c, d, e, f, g and h are known planets of TRAPPIST-1. (stored)

planet_order.says: The planets of TRAPPIST-1 are b, c, d, e, f, g, h in order outward from the star. (stored)

order_rules.says: Farther-than (from the star) is transitive and asymmetric.
z3: ForAll([p, q, s], Implies(And(farther_than(p, q), farther_than(q, s)), farther_than(p, s)))
ForAll([p, q], Implies(farther_than(p, q), Not(farther_than(q, p))))

no_other_planet.says: No known planet of TRAPPIST-1 is missing from the named ones. (closed list)

stores: number_of_members(trappist1) == count(located_in(trappist_1b, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1c, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1d, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1e, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1f, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1g, trappist1), located_in(trappist_1h, trappist1), located_in(tirrelune, trappist1), located_in(other_planet, trappist1))
ForAll(p, Implies(And(located_in(p, trappist1), p != outermost(trappist1)), farther_than(outermost(trappist1), p)))
